sentences.en: We are the pioneers of this new branch of science.
sentences.zh: 我们是这一新科学领域的先驱。

sentences.en: Paracelsus pioneered the use of chemicals and minerals in medicine.
sentences.zh: 帕拉塞尔苏斯开创了在医学中使用化学物质和矿物质的先河。

sentences.en: He did pioneering work in the field of physical geography.
sentences.zh: 他在物理地理学领域做出了开拓性的工作。
